en: A tinted night‑view postcard showing a river curving through a town. On the left bank stands a skyline with a tall, narrow church spire and other historic buildings; on the right rises a high embankment or fortification wall with large multi‑story houses or a palace‑like structure at the top. Above the scene a bird (likely a dove) flies while carrying a small calendar page reading "Januar 1", suggesting a New Year greeting. The overall color tone is dark with a yellowish sky reflected in the river.
